reasons: Claimed status is compliant, and consistent with that, the rendered redline is identical to the original paragraphs and no counterparty comment is proposed — nothing is being raised as a negotiation issue.

The cited text supports the compliance conclusion: 11.1.1.3(a) vests exclusive ownership of all Trial Inventions in PB (our party) with assignment from SFJ, its Affiliates and Permitted Third Parties; 11.1.1.3(b)-(c) require, where assignment is unavailable, a worldwide, royalty-free, fully-paid, freely-assignable licence with multi-tier sublicensing rights (functionally irrevocable, successor-transferable, and extendable to our Affiliates/contractors); 11.1.1.4 transfers sole ownership of the Trial Data Package and Research Results to PB.
No revocable-at-will grant or affiliate/contractor exclusion runs against us; 11.1.1.6 ('No Other Rights') limits SFJ's rights and is protective of our party, so flagging would be over-flagging.

Deterministic checks (affiliates covered; no at-will revocation) both pass, and the rationale properly relegates minor points (commercially reasonable efforts qualifier, contractor background-technology carve-out, AZ License precedence) to noted sub-elements rather than deviations.
